smyx-cage-cleanliness-detection-analysis v1.0.0

- Initial release: AI-powered detection of cage cleanliness via fixed cameras for pet boarding centers, pet shops, animal hospitals, and breeding facilities.
- Analyzes floor images to identify and quantify feces/urine area; triggers alerts if coverage exceeds preset threshold (e.g. 5%).
- Supports both scheduled and on-demand image/video analysis; delivers structured cleanliness reports.
- Strict open-id retrieval and usage protocols; mandatory for analysis and historical report queries.
- Automated, Markdown-formatted reporting of cleanliness history with clickable links to detailed reports.
- Bilingual documentation (English/Chinese) with step-by-step usage instructions and guidelines.
